entry_thesis: Nebius Group (NBIS) is the WSB 2026 Index #5 pick with Reddit sentiment recovering sharply from a post-earnings panic sell — retail fear-sold a revenue 'miss' that masked a stunning 547% YoY growth and EPS beat (-$0.68 vs -$1.029 consensus), and the community is now calling it the most asymmetric AI infrastructure play on the market. Reddit sentiment climbed from a bearish 35 in mid-February back to a bullish 72 in early March as investors digest the $19.4B Microsoft deal already on the books and anticipate further mega-deal announcements; unusual options call flow of $1.28M+ in early March expiry strikes signals institutional smart money loading up alongside the retail re-accumulation narrative. With the stock near ~$88-92 and analyst consensus targets at $130-157 (40-70% upside), the Fear & Greed Index sitting at ~27 (Fear zone) creates classic sentiment-driven rebound conditions — fear overhang is the entry point, not the risk.
risk: Broader tariff-driven risk-off sentiment could keep high-multiple AI names suppressed; any macro deterioration or VIX spike above 25 would pressure speculative growth stocks disproportionately before the sentiment recovery fully materializes.
catalyst: Reddit/WSB re-accumulation post-earnings panic sell, massive Microsoft $19.4B AI cloud deal narrative building retail FOMO, unusual options call flow ($1.28M+ premium in March/April strikes), analyst consensus $130+ target implying 40%+ upside creating 'too cheap to ignore' narrative on WSB, Fear & Greed recovery from Fear zone historically triggers sharp short-covering and retail FOMO in high-conviction community names
